test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the given statements and decide which of the assumptions from the options is NOT implicit in the statements.

Some trucks are bikes.

Some tyres are not bikes but trucks.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e5f070e916dcb81591ec7ebbd08352cf9609112a508d572e6787ac123041e6f.png] 

i) Some bikes are trucks. **→ **True

ii) Some bikes are tyres. **→ **False (As no direct relation is given between Bike to tyre thus it is possible but not definite)

iii) Some tyres are trucks. **→ **True

iv) Some trucks are tyres. **→ **True

Hence, ' Some bikes are tyres.' is NOT implicit in the statements.
